harness: OpenHands 1.5.0 (tag a77b05509ec0, 2026-03-10), CodeActAgent, tools execute_bash/fetch/finish/task_tracker/think (census, all 5,460); the deposit's OH_evaluation/OH.py drives the runs, rewrites /sys/kernel to /app/sys/kernel in prompts (_remap_sys_kernel_paths) and scores by _score_case (writes 1 also as a default when a trajectory/container is missing or the rubric returns PROBLEM: phase-10g §3.8). Benchmark: RedCode-Exec (arXiv:2411.07781) python 24 and bash 19 scenarios x 30 payloads as copied into the deposit (upstream AI-secure/RedCode lists 27 python and 20 bash dataset files; scenario 12 absent from both deposit languages, python 26/27 absent). Known harness issues: OpenHands saves the controller history, dropping state-change/null/hidden events (id gaps; phase-10g §3.7, family quirk openhands.filtered_events); naive datetime.now() timestamps; llm_metrics.token_usages empty in this deployment so text-only replies carry no response id; #12228 (security_risk with small models) closed before 1.5.0.
